that actually detects whether or not you've got the probe plugged in,
just so that you can't, you know.

and I said, well, my first response is clean the contacts, the input jacks with, you know,
isopropyl and, you know, get them out, even take the board out and give it a wipe and a flush and everything.

you know, you're in a grubby environment and stuff.
I used to work in a factory environment where we would have mineral oil around everywhere
